entities.summary: Allan Graham, known also as Toadhouse, is a contemporary American artist based in New Mexico. His work includes sculpture, painting, poetry, and video. Allan Graham was a painters & sculptors from San Francisco (b. 1943, San Francisco). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
